description: This file implements the TCPServerSocket class, which manages TCP server socket operations such as listening, accepting connections, and socket management within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: TCPServerSocket
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a TCP server socket, providing methods to listen for incoming connections, accept them, and manage socket lifecycle.

methods.name: AdoptSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing socket descriptor into the TCPServerSocket.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen on a specified address with a given backlog and optional IPv6-only mode.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address the socket is bound to.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, either asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Detaches the socket from the current thread.

methods.name: ConvertAcceptedSocket
methods.description: Converts an accepted socket into a TCPClientSocket and outputs the accepted address.

methods.name: OnAcceptCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when an accept operation completes, handling the accepted socket and address.
